_comment: A person's verdict on what a rule did to one line (or one page), when no golden case
in data/ingredients/expectations.json settles it. Read by src/lib/rule-scores.ts; a
verdict here outranks the golden case. The Rules tab in the admin shows the scores.
rule     — the rule id as the Rules tab shows it: 'pattern:parmesan', 'line:stated-grams'
subject  — the line exactly as published (or the page URL for an extract: rule)
verdict  — 'right' if the rule's change was correct, 'wrong' if it made the line worse
by, at   — who decided, and the date
Gates (gate:*) are judged on the look-up list instead: set `confirmed` on the entry in
